func mapItems(list, value expression) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		items, err := present(list, context, at+"/list")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		values, ok := items.([]any)
		if !ok {
			return nil, refusal(at, "collection_value", "mapping requires a list")
		}
		out := make([]any, 0, len(values))
		for index, item := range values {
			result, err := present(value, scope{input: context.input, item: item, index: int64(index), bound: true}, at+"/value")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			out = append(out, result)
		}
		return out, nil
	}
}

	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		items, err := present(list, context, at+"/list")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		values, ok := items.([]any)
		if !ok {
			return nil, refusal(at, "collection_value", "counting requires a list")
		}
		keys := map[string]bool{}
		for index, item := range values {
			inner := scope{input: context.input, item: item, index: int64(index), bound: true}
			selected, err := test(inner, at+"/condition")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if !selected {
				continue
			}
			value, err := present(key, inner, at+"/key")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			text, ok := value.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, refusal(at, "count_key", "distinct category key is not a string")
			}
			keys[text] = true
		}
		return int64(len(keys)), nil
	}

func concatText(parts []expression) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		var out strings.Builder

			text, err := stringValue(part, context, fmt.Sprintf("%s/parts/%d", at, index))
			if err != nil {

func joinText(list, separator expression) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		input, err := present(list, context, at+"/list")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		values, err := array(input, at+"/list")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		sep, err := stringValue(separator, context, at+"/separator")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		texts := make([]string, 0, len(values))
		for _, value := range values {
			text, ok := value.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, refusal(at+"/list", "string_value", "joining requires string elements")
			}
			texts = append(texts, text)
		}
		return strings.Join(texts, sep), nil
	}
}
func integerText(value expression) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		input, err := present(value, context, at+"/value")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		number, err := integer(input, at+"/value")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return strconv.FormatInt(number, 10), nil
	}
}
func concatLists(lists []expression) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		out := []any{}
		for index, list := range lists {
			at := fmt.Sprintf("%s/lists/%d", at, index)
			input, err := present(list, context, at)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			values, err := array(input, at)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			out = append(out, values...)
		}
		return out, nil
	}
